messages.author: 0111ed37d2662b85
messages.subject: save a nimble MCMC object?
parts:
Hello nimble users and developers,

Thanks very much for all your hard work building and maintaining nimble. I have a model + data + mcmc configuration that can take a long time to build and compile. I was wondering if it is feasible/possible to save (ideally compiled) MCMC objects created by nimble to be shared across machines and re-used in new R instances.

I looked through the documentation and user group messages for the answer to this question, but my apologies if this answer exists and I just couldn't find it.

Thanks very much,
Henry

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: save a nimble MCMC object?
parts:
Unfortunately, it is not easily possible.  It is something we are working on, but it will take some time before it is released.  We realize it's a big issue.
-Perry
